dedupe_keys.name: tra oman telecom open data broadband by technology and governorate mobile and fixed subscriptions infrastructure usage investment and revenue

description: The Telecommunications Regulatory Authority of Oman publishes an open data section under the national open government data policy of June 2020. Its statistics index lists 29 datasets for the telecom sector: broadband subscriptions by technology and by governorate, mobile and fixed service subscriptions, investment in the sector, service revenues, infrastructure indicators, usage indicators, employment and type approvals. Each dataset has metadata naming the source (the licensed operators such as Omantel, Ooredoo, Awasr and Starlink), update frequency and variables, and can be viewed as a chart or downloaded. A sector indicators tab holds 138 reports, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly and annual, including quarterly telecom indicators to the second quarter of 2026, half-yearly market indicators and a five-year market report for 2020 to 2024. A licensing tab lists licensed and authorised companies with their licences. Coverage: Oman, national and by governorate. Format and access: web tables with downloads and PDF reports, free under the authority's open data use licence. Caveats: the pages are script-heavy and download formats were not confirmed; reports are mostly in Arabic. Simulation uses: governorate-level broadband take-up by technology and national demand, traffic and investment series for Omani telecom models. Related records: the ITU ICT statistics give comparable national series; the TeleGeography submarine cable map covers Oman's many cable landings.
name: TRA Oman telecom open data: broadband by technology and governorate, mobile and fixed subscriptions, infrastructure, usage, investment and revenue
notes: Open data pages read with curl on 2026-09-26 (dataset index, report list, licence link). The download format is inferred; XLSX was not seen.
